verdict.rationale: Zep documents only three ingestible data types: JSON, text, and message. No evidence shows it accepts images, PDFs, or other files as memory inputs. The passing mention that the Context Graph is built from "documents" does not show file or image ingestion, and converting files to text first would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store images, PDFs, or other files as memory inputs and recall information from them later
